notes: Tread i (0-indexed) occupies theta in [i*dtheta, (i+1)*dtheta], r in [inner_radius, outer_radius], Z in [(i+1)*rise_per_tread - tread_thickness, (i+1)*rise_per_tread], where dtheta = 2*pi\n_treads and rise_per_tread = total_rise\n_treads. Every tread sector must approximate its inner and outer arcs with >= arc_segments_per_tread straight segments. The central column is a column_segments-sided circular prism centred on Z axis, running continuously from Z = 0 to Z = total_rise.
